QuestInfo.name: Regained Will Power
QuestInfo.1: I received the #b#t4031463##k from #p2040050#.  Should I be giving this bracelet to #b#p2060100##k? But I desperately need the will power... \n\n#i4031463##t4031463# #b#c4031463# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: When I give the bracelet to #p2060100#, she gave me #b#t2280002##k. Now I got the will power back, but do I need to worry about #p2060100#?  I think #p2040050# might've put some secret device on the bracelet...that makes me feel a little better

0.0: Finally, you came! #t4031463# is completed. I don't feel good about this... #p2060100# has got the magical metal, #t4011002#. She is the witch under the sea. She can't have influence.

yes.0: I don't think you're bad. I don't know why you deal with #b#p2060100##k. After that, please keep an eye on her. She might use bad magic.

no.0: You don't get this? You're not going to deal with #p2060100#?

1.0: Good. This is the old bracelet. If #t4011002#'s power is added, it will become greater.
1.1: Then I'll give you medicine. The power to wake up the will. This is medicine containing #r#q1121011##k. Make good use of it. I'll say 'Thank you' for getting me my bracelet.

yes.0: What's this bracelet? This magic picture wasn't here. Wandering Alchemist... What did you do to my bracelet?

npc.0: You're not going to Carta? That's a relief...

item.0: If you don't give me #b#t4031463##k, I won't give you the medicine. I won't make the medicine without any reward.

lost.0: You forgot #b#t4031463##k. I felt the energy of #b#t4011002##k somewhere and I found the source. It's what you gave to me. Here you are.
